title: ERCOT HB_WEST: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-26, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: ERCOT via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables ercot_dam_hub_prices, ercot_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-09-28.
citations: Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT). NP4-190-CD: DAM Settlement Point Prices. https://www.ercot.com/mp/data-products/data-product-details?id=NP4-190-CD. Retrieved 2026-09-28 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table ercot_dam_hub_prices, data commit 2c667859235e.

Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT). NP6-785-ER: Historical RTM Load Zone and Hub Prices. https://www.ercot.com/mp/data-products/data-product-details?id=NP6-785-ER. Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT). NP6-905-CD: Settlement Point Prices at Resource Nodes, Hubs and Load Zones. https://www.ercot.com/mp/data-products/data-product-details?id=NP6-905-CD. Retrieved 2026-09-28 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table ercot_rtm_hub_prices, data commit 2c667859235e.
facts: ERCOT HB_WEST, 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-26: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 19:00 local, 30.41 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 00:00, -0.29 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-26: 7.09 USD/MWh.
